puzzles.name: 底线杀
puzzles.hint: 它自己的兵挡住了退路。
puzzles.hintEn: Its own pawns block the escape.

puzzles.name: 王后加国王
puzzles.hint: 国王已经封住了第七横线。
puzzles.hintEn: Your king already covers the seventh rank.

puzzles.name: 闷杀
puzzles.hint: 它被自己的子围死了，只差一匹马。
puzzles.hintEn: It is boxed in by its own pieces; one knight will do.

puzzles.name: 学者杀
puzzles.hint: f7 只有国王在守。
puzzles.hintEn: Only the king guards f7.

puzzles.name: 双车
puzzles.hint: 一个车封第七横线，另一个车将军。
puzzles.hintEn: One rook holds the seventh rank, the other gives check.

puzzles.name: 车梯
puzzles.hint: 先封住它的退路，再将军。
puzzles.hintEn: Cut off the escape first, then check.

puzzles.name: 菲利道尔的遗赠
puzzles.hint: 把王后送掉，逼它自己把门堵上。
puzzles.hintEn: Give up the queen so it blocks its own door.
